lines.cap: Swallowed gum stays in your stomach for seven years? Here's the truth.
lines.say: Swallowed gum stays in your stomach for seven years? Here's the truth.

lines.cap: Almost everyone heard it as a kid. Don't swallow your gum!
lines.say: Almost everyone heard it as a kid. Don't swallow your gum!

lines.cap: It's true that your body can't fully digest gum base. It's a rubbery material that stomach acid can't break down.
lines.say: It's true that your body can't fully digest gum base. It's a rubbery material that stomach acid can't break down.

lines.cap: But your gut doesn't need to break it down. It just keeps things moving.
lines.say: But your gut doesn't need to break it down. It just keeps things moving.

lines.cap: Like other things you can't digest, it passes through, and out the other end, usually within a few days.
lines.say: Like other things you can't digest, it passes through, and out the other end, usually within a few days.

lines.cap: The only real problem is swallowing a lot of gum, often, especially for small kids. Doctors have seen rare blockages.
lines.say: The only real problem is swallowing a lot of gum, often, especially for small kids. Doctors have seen rare blockages.

lines.cap: So one piece won't stay for seven years. It'll be gone by the weekend.
